messages.subject: Re: error/ when use with skyline relative to global standard
parts:
This sounds like it might be caused by a change I made to Skyline-Daily last month where the "Standard Type" column in the MSstats Input report now says "Global Standard" when it used to say "Normalization".
I will probably have to update the MSstats external tool so that it can handle either value.

I will contact you by email about how to send me your Skyline document so I can figure out what is going wrong.

messages.author: 99540594784b9805
messages.subject: Re: error/ when use with skyline relative to global standard
parts:
Sandra,

Thank you for sending me your Skyline document.
It looks like there is a bug in MSstats which prevents you from doing Global Standard normalization if you have precursor ions in your Skyline document.
(The MSstats code that is supposed to combine the precursor areas into a single row is also obliterating the "StandardType" column.)
I will forward this information on to the MSstats team so that they can fix this.
